description: This file defines several attribute classes related to grain placement strategies within the Orleans framework, including base and specific placement attributes, as well as immovability options for grains.

classes.name: PlacementAttribute
classes.description: Abstract base class for all placement policy marker attributes, providing a placement strategy and a method to populate grain properties.

classes.name: RandomPlacementAttribute
classes.description: Marks a grain class to use the RandomPlacement policy; default for grains.

classes.name: HashBasedPlacementAttribute
classes.description: Marks a grain class to use the HashBasedPlacement policy.

classes.name: PreferLocalPlacementAttribute
classes.description: Marks a grain class to prefer local placement.

classes.name: ActivationCountBasedPlacementAttribute
classes.description: Marks a grain class to use activation count-based placement policy, balancing server load.

classes.name: SiloRoleBasedPlacementAttribute
classes.description: Marks a grain class to use silo role-based placement policy.

classes.name: ResourceOptimizedPlacementAttribute
classes.description: Marks a grain class to use resource-optimized placement policy.

classes.name: ImmovableAttribute
classes.description: Attributes to specify that activations of this grain type are immovable; includes kind of immovability.

methods.name: PlacementAttribute..ctor
methods.description: Constructor initializing placement strategy, throws if null.

methods.name: PlacementAttribute.Populate
methods.description: Populates grain properties using the placement strategy.

methods.name: ImmovableAttribute..ctor
methods.description: Constructor specifying immovable kind, default is 'Any'.

methods.name: ImmovableAttribute.Populate
methods.description: Sets immovable property in the grain properties dictionary.
